title: Sodium-Ion Energy Storage Commercialization State Map
scope: Stationary battery energy storage systems only; vehicle, starter-battery, and solid-state battery claims are excluded.
decision_question: Has sodium-ion stationary storage crossed from product and production claims into a procurable, delivered, commissioned technology with public field-operating evidence?

records.accepted_support: Sodium-ion technology and a planned industrial-chain target were publicly announced.
records.does_not_support: Stationary BESS customer delivery, commissioning, or field-operating history.

records.accepted_support: Naxtra sodium-ion products were publicly launched with manufacturer-attributed mass-production claims.
records.does_not_support: A delivered or commissioned stationary storage system.

records.accepted_support: Two counterparties publicly described a three-year 60 GWh sodium-ion energy-storage cooperation agreement.
records.does_not_support: Shipment, customer acceptance, commissioning, grid connection, or operating performance.

records.accepted_support: TENER Sodium was publicly launched as a stationary BESS product and future delivery milestones were stated.
records.does_not_support: Completed customer delivery or a named commissioned customer site as of the knowledge cutoff. The phrase field-validated remains source-attributed.

records.accepted_support: TENER Sodium was publicly showcased and a Brazil market partnership was announced.
records.does_not_support: A named commissioned sodium-ion BESS or public field-performance dataset.

next_transition_evidence: Named customer shipment and acceptance record
Named site commissioning or grid-connection record
Dated operating history tied to that system
update_rule: New evidence is appended with event time and knowledge time. A state changes only when the new record meets the stated threshold; previous records remain visible and may be superseded, not overwritten.
